Name: Eldad
Summary: Eldad was one of the seventy elders on whom the Spirit rested in the wilderness; though he stayed in the camp, he prophesied there.
KeyStory: When the Spirit fell on the elders, Eldad prophesied in the camp, and Moses refused to stop him, wishing all the LORD's people were prophets.
LifeLesson: God's Spirit is not confined to the place where we expect Him.
